services.title: My services
services.description: Where you watch and listen, with the address your apps need.
services.emptyText: Once your admin sets up your accounts, your media servers show up here.

hint.ready: Sign in with your Starr username and password.
hint.activate: Starr needs your password once to set up this account.
hint.oldPassword: This account still has the password you used before. Switch to your Starr password when it suits you.
hint.oldPasswordLater: This account still has the password you used before. Switching becomes possible once your admin turns on account writes.
hint.settingUp: Starr is setting up this account right now. This takes a moment.
hint.suspended: Your access is paused. Ask your admin.
hint.activateLocked: Starr locked this account with a random password, because this server has no off switch. Enter your password once to unlock it.
hint.suspendedLocked: Your access is paused, and Starr locked this account with a random password. Once your admin reactivates you, your Starr password unlocks it.
hint.undecided: Your admin hasn't decided about an account here yet. Once they do, it shows up as ready or asks for your password.
hint.waiting: Your admin has to look at this account first.

services.noAddress: Ask your admin for the server address.
services.activateText: Enter your Starr password. Starr uses it once to set up your accounts and keeps no copy.
services.switchText: From then on you sign in to {{name}} with your Starr password. Your old password stops working there.
services.switchSignsOut: All your devices signed in to {{name}} will be signed out. Sign in again with your Starr password.
services.activated: Thanks. Your accounts are being set up.

intro.ready: Sign in to these apps with your Starr username and password.
intro.activate: Starr needs your password once to finish your accounts. Then you sign in everywhere with your Starr username and password.
intro.oldPassword: Some accounts still use the password you had before; the cards say which. The others take your Starr password.
intro.notYet: Some accounts aren't ready yet; each card says what it waits for. Ready ones take your Starr username and password.
intro.suspended: Your access is paused. Ask your admin.

waitingFor.nameTaken: Your username is already taken there. Your admin decides whether that account is yours or picks another way; until then nothing changes.
waitingFor.locked: The server locked this account after too many failed sign-ins. Ask your admin to unlock it.
waitingFor.writesOff: Starr sets up this account once your admin turns on account changes for this server. Nothing for you to do.
waitingFor.admin: Your admin has to finish something on this server first. Nothing for you to do.

services.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

profile.title: Profile

profile.sessionsDescription: Where you're signed in right now.
